LanguageData.LP_AarakocraWings.label: wings
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraWings.description: A pair of broad wings on the back. Aarakocra can "Soar" to any standable spot within 12 cells; walls, fences, water and buildings cannot stop them, but they cannot fly under a mountain. Usable drafted or undrafted, handy for hopping walls during work.
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraHollowBones.label: hollow bones
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraHollowBones.description: The light, hollow bones of the aarakocra. Actual body size is 90% of a normal human (eats less, harder to hit), but the bones are brittle: +10% blunt damage taken.
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraSkyborn.label: born to fly
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraSkyborn.description: Aarakocra born under the sky walk fast (move speed ×110%) and get +2 mood when working without a roof. But staying awake under a roof for a full hour makes them feel caged (mood -3); a short while outdoors fixes it. Sleeping does not count.
LanguageData.LP_SkinAarakocra.label: aarakocra skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinAarakocra.description: The light brown skin of the aarakocra, close to the color of their feathers.
